body:
Hi,

Do you have a reproducer for this? I can't seem to reproduce the problem in out testsuite.

The problem is, that the includeAll tag is working fine during the test phase, but not if you start the application with "mvn quarkus:dev".
So, providing a test case (@QuarkusTest) is of no use.

But I can try to set-up a simple Quarkus project to demonstrate this.

> The problem is, that the includeAll tag is working fine during the test phase, but not if you start the application with "mvn quarkus:dev".
> So, providing a test case (@QuarkusTest) is of no use.
> 

Yeah, I get that. What I meant was that doing `quarkus:dev` on our liquibase integration test, things worked fine.

> But I can try to set-up a simple Quarkus project to demonstrate this.

:+1:

Can you give me a hint were you´ve executed the `quarkus:dev` command, so that I can have a look at that configuration.
Maybe I´m doing something wrong or have a different configuration.
Thanks

This is where I tried it: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/tree/master/integration-tests/liquibase

It could very well be that the integration test isn't doing enough, in which case a reproducer for the issue would be great so we can not only fix the issue, but also improve coverage
Our test uses `<include>`. Apparently, that one is working, it's `<includeAll>` not working. At least, that's what I understood.

Yes, exactly.
I just had a look at the sources as well and the liquibase tests are using `include`.

The `include` is working in my environment, just not the `includeAll`.
